name: aichivist
description: Clean up your files like an archivist – Claude renames, sorts and de-duplicates, you approve every step.
long_description: Claude reads your documents, proposes a filing plan you approve, keeps catalogs, logs every step and can undo it. Closed collections are sealed with SHA-256 checksums and exportable as BagIt packages. Program data such as game folders or photo libraries is left alone, and it checks whether your backups follow the 3-2-1 rule. Claude only sees the folders you choose; excluded folders stay invisible.

folders.title: Folders to organize
folders.description: Claude can only see and file documents inside these folders.

excluded.title: Never open (optional)
excluded.description: Folders inside the ones above that Claude must never see, e.g. health records.

rules.title: Filing rules (optional)
rules.description: Your rules file (see templates/RULES.md). Without it, Claude asks where things belong.

prompts.name: tidy_up
prompts.description: File the documents in a folder with a plan you approve
prompts.text: Please tidy up ${arguments.folder} with aichivist: read the rules, propose a filing plan, and wait for my approval before applying it.
